content: Nebius Token Factory offers an OpenAI-compatible API for inference and fine-tuning. The API base URL is https://api.tokenfactory.nebius.com/v1 and requests are authorized with a NEBIUS_API_KEY.
title: Nebius Token Factory documentation — Introduction

content: The ODSC x Nebius Hackathon asks participants to build a research agent that brings its sources. Submissions are a public repository with a README and a short demo, due November 20, 2026.
title: ODSC x Nebius Hackathon — Build a research agent that brings its sources
